path-parameters
Target file: tests/test_path_parameters.py
Implementation module: posting.urls

INTERFACE AND ACCEPTANCE CONTRACT
extract_path_param_names(url) returns unique :name placeholders in path order, ignoring ::escaped tokens and query/fragment. substitute_path_params(url,params) replaces supplied path placeholders, retains unknown ones, unescapes :: to : in the path, and leaves query/fragment unchanged. Names start with letter or underscore.

CONTEXT

Dependencies are supplied by the environment. Use temporary storage and mock external I/O. The task plan lists independent behavioral slices, not completed implementation steps.

FROZEN PUBLIC INTERFACE CLARIFICATION (development revision lr-v01)
Public signatures: extract_path_param_names(url: str) -> list[str]; substitute_path_params(url: str, params: dict[str, str]) -> str. Returned names are bare strings without a colon, unique in first-occurrence order. Placeholder name grammar is [A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*. Escaped double-colon tokens are not placeholders. Extraction and substitution operate only on the URL path; substitution also unescapes double colons in that path. Query and fragment are preserved. Behavior on malformed URLs is outside this task.

query-pair-merge
Target file: tests/test_query_pair_merge.py
Implementation module: posting.urls

INTERFACE AND ACCEPTANCE CONTRACT
extract_query_pairs(url) retains duplicate keys, blanks and ordering. merge_url_query_into_params(url, params) matches table (name,value,enabled) triples to URL occurrences in order. Nonempty table values win; empty table values use URL values; preserve disabled flags, unmatched URL rows (enabled=True), and unmatched table rows. Return URL with query removed, preserving path/fragment. With escape_dollars=True percent-encoded dollar signs decode to doubled dollars for later literal-template handling.

CONTEXT
Python 3.13 and pytest. Import the named module through its normal import path. No implementation or existing tests are supplied. All fixtures belong in this test file. Dependencies are supplied by the environment. Use temporary storage and mock external I/O. The task plan lists independent behavioral slices, not completed implementation steps.

FROZEN PUBLIC INTERFACE CLARIFICATION (development revision lr-v01)
Public signatures: extract_query_pairs(url: str, *, escape_dollars: bool = False) -> list[tuple[str, str]]; merge_url_query_into_params(url: str, params: list[tuple[str, str, bool]], *, escape_dollars: bool = False) -> tuple[str, list[tuple[str, str, bool]]]. The merge result is (URL with its query removed, merged triples), preserving the fragment. URL occurrences determine the initial result order; each consumes at most one same-name table occurrence in table order. Unmatched URL pairs become enabled triples; unconsumed table triples follow in their original order. Table enabled flags survive matched occurrences. With no URL pairs, return the unchanged URL and table values. escape_dollars=True makes percent-encoded %24 literal dollar data into doubled dollars before query decoding, for either function. Do not impose behavior for malformed URLs or other percent-encoding spellings.

request-filenames
Target file: tests/test_request_filenames.py
Implementation module: posting.files

INTERFACE AND ACCEPTANCE CONTRACT
is_valid_filename rejects empty/whitespace, native path separators, >255 characters, Windows device names with optional extension, dot-prefixed, dot-suffixed and double-dot names. Ordinary filenames are valid. get_unique_request_filename(name,directory) returns an unused .posting.yaml name; repeated collisions advance a two-digit -01/-02 suffix. It proposes a name without creating files. Test exact .posting.yaml collisions; mixed .yml extensions and numbered-input policy are outside this task.

Public signatures: is_valid_filename(filename: str) -> bool; get_unique_request_filename(file_name: str, parent_directory: pathlib.Path) -> str. The proposed result is a basename, not a full path. Supply a basename already ending in .posting.yaml. With no collision the name is unchanged. For an unnumbered input, existing exact .posting.yaml collisions select the first unused two-digit -01, -02, etc. basename. The operation is stateless and creates no files. Native separators mean os.path.sep and os.path.altsep when present on the executing platform; this is not a general Windows-character validator. Reserved device basenames are case-insensitive CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM1 through COM9 and LPT1 through LPT9, including an optional single extension. Multi-extension reserved names, other invalid characters, mixed .yml collisions and already-numbered input policy are outside this task.

session-undo-redo
Target file: tests/test_session_undo_redo.py
Implementation module: posting.session_variables

INTERFACE AND ACCEPTANCE CONTRACT
SessionVariables starts with empty values. set(name,value) records an edit; revert(name) removes an override and returns True, or False if absent. undo()/redo() return the affected name, restoring prior override presence/value, or None when unavailable. A new editor edit clears redo. values is publicly readable; avoid private history inspection.

CONTEXT

FROZEN PUBLIC INTERFACE CLARIFICATION (development revision lr-v01)
Public API: SessionVariables(); .values is a public mutable dict[str, object], not a method; .set(name: str, value: str) -> None; .revert(name: str) -> bool; .undo() -> str | None; .redo() -> str | None. Successful revert is itself an undoable editor edit. Reverting an absent name returns False without altering history or redo. set and successful revert clear redo. Undo and redo restore the affected name's previous override presence/value and return that name; an unavailable operation returns None. A removed override means the key is absent, not mapped to an empty string. Do not inspect private history.

session-history-limit
Target file: tests/test_session_history_limit.py
Implementation module: posting.session_variables

INTERFACE AND ACCEPTANCE CONTRACT
SessionVariables retains the latest 50 editor edits. Direct script writes to values do not add history; a later editor edit snapshots that script value, including non-string types. Undoing all retained edits stops at the retained boundary. Use public set/undo/values only.

CONTEXT

Dependencies are supplied by the environment. Use temporary storage and mock external I/O. The task plan lists independent behavioral slices, not completed implementation steps.

FROZEN PUBLIC INTERFACE CLARIFICATION (development revision lr-v01)
Public API: SessionVariables(); .values is a public mutable dict[str, object], not a method; .set(name: str, value: str) -> None; .undo() -> str | None. Scripts write directly through state.values[name] = value. Such writes add no history entry, but a later editor set snapshots that exact prior value including its type. Only the most recent 50 editor edits are retained, not merely 50 current variable keys. Undo those retained edits individually; once exhausted, undo returns None without changing values. Earlier dropped edits cannot be undone. Use public set/undo/values only.
